list: Official 55-trophy list as published by PlayStation and mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles, November 2026
note: Names and descriptions are the official list. Guides are original writing for this entry. Where a step is not yet confirmed in-game, the guide says so: the game launched 19 November 2026 and launch-era guides are still confirming the vague trophies.
sources: Official trophy list - PlayStation, as mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles
Push Square - GTA 6 trophy list report

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is no separate task for the Platinum: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so it is really a prize for finishing everything else in this guide. Work through the roadmap phases in order and it arrives on its own. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours to the Platinum, and notes there are no online trophies, so nothing here needs another player.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end and it unlocks when the mission completes. It is the first story trophy on the list, so it should pop very early in your playthrough. Source: the official description, confirmed as a story mission by PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Before the chapter closes, do the one thing this guide warns about: the optional meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude), because that moment is gone after Chapter 1. Source: the official description; the meditation warning is from PowerPyx.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Chapter 2 is also when you first get to play as both characters together, after the mission Coffee Break according to PowerPyx, which opens up the dual-character activities later in this guide. Source: the official description; the Coffee Break detail is from PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and it unlocks at the chapter's end. The robbery trophies start opening up around this part of the story, so keep an eye out for bank vaults and armored trucks while you play through it. Source: the official description; the robbery timing is from GTABase's trophy notes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and it unlocks at the chapter's end. You are one chapter from the finale at this point, so before moving on, make a manual save: there is no mission replay in this game, and a save per chapter is the safety net every launch-era guide recommends. Source: the official description; the no-replay warning is from PowerPyx and GTABase.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy and one of only two Golds on the list. Finish the final mission and it unlocks at the credits. It is the only hidden Gold. After the credits the game opens up free roam, so anything you have not finished yet can still be done. Source: the official description; the free-roam-after-story detail is from PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story and the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is a named-mission trophy, so it cannot be missed as long as you play the story through. Source: the official description, which names the mission itself.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story and the trophy pops at the mission's end. GTABase places this heist in Chapter 3. Heists are story beats, so just keep playing the main missions and it will come. Source: the official description; the Chapter 3 placement is from GTABase.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play when it appears in the story and the trophy pops at the mission's end. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is tied to story progress and cannot be missed. Source: the official description, which names the mission itself.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners when it appears in the story and the trophy pops at the mission's end. The name is a stylised spelling from the official list, shown here exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Source: the official description, which names the mission itself.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story and the trophy pops at the mission's end. VCIA is the Vice City airport, so expect this one to involve aircraft or the airfield. Source: the official description, which names the mission itself.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the story and the trophy pops at the mission's end. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies before the finale, so it should arrive late in your playthrough. Source: the official description, which names the mission itself.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the second Gold. Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which only opens after you finish the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, according to PowerPyx and GTABase. Progress made during the story still counts. The checklist covers story missions, optional tasks, robberies, fencing totals, collectibles, activities and scanning, and PowerPyx estimates the whole Platinum run at about 200 hours. Nothing on the checklist is permanently missable, both guides agree, so this is a long grind, not a trap. Save it for the final phase of the roadmap. Source: the official description; checklist details from PowerPyx and GTABase.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total, a count PlayStation tracks for you. Stunts are the driving tricks the game registers, such as jumps, near misses and long airtime, and the counter builds up naturally across the whole playthrough. If it is short near the end, chain jumps and airtime in free roam rather than hunting a single spot. The exact list of moves that count as a stunt is not yet confirmed in-game, so this guide does not invent one: the official description and the tracked count of 250 are the source. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each activity type in the game, once each. The tracked total is 9 activity types, and the list includes the things this guide covers elsewhere: fishing, arcade games, drone racing, regular racing, shooting range challenges, bowling and meditation among them. Work down the activities section of this guide one by one and it pops when the last type is tried. Which exact activities fill the 9 slots is not yet fully confirmed in-game, so tick them off as the tracker shows them. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges, a count PlayStation tracks. That means gold on all 42, not just completing them, so expect this to be one of the grindier Silvers: learn each range's layout, pick the right weapon for the distance, and replay the ones that fall short of gold. The ranges are an activity you can revisit any time in free roam, so nothing here can be missed. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 42.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations, a count PlayStation tracks. Each location is a separate race, so you need a win at every one, not 14 wins at the same spot. Learn the racing line for each course, cut corners where the gates allow, and remember the races can be retried as often as you like. Where each of the 14 locations sits on the map is not yet confirmed in-game, so this guide does not list them yet. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 14.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: the same race won twice counts once, so you need 20 distinct race events across Leonida. Mix vehicle types and districts as you go, and use the in-game race menu to see which ones you have already won. Races are repeatable in free roam, so nothing here can be missed. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat the angler Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the game's activities, and Cal is a rival fisherman you face in a head-to-head challenge. The challenge is a contest of catches, so bring your best fishing setup and take your time on the cast. Where and when Cal's challenge appears is not yet confirmed in-game, so this guide does not invent a location: the official description is the source, and the method will be confirmed as launch-era guides pin it down.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game, start to finish. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida, start a game and play it through to its end rather than quitting halfway. Any cabinet should count, so pick the game you find easiest. Which arcade games exist and where the cabinets are is not yet confirmed in-game, so this guide does not list them yet. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Andy's mission strand. Andy is one of the side characters with a chain of missions, and this trophy pops when his final one is done. Side strands can be finished in free roam after the story, according to PowerPyx, so do not rush it during the main missions. Where Andy's strand begins is not yet confirmed in-game. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Kenton's mission strand. Kenton is one of the side characters with a chain of missions, and this trophy pops when his final one is done. Side strands can be finished in free roam after the story, according to PowerPyx, so it is safe to leave for the second phase of the roadmap. Where Kenton's strand begins is not yet confirmed in-game. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Billy's mission strand. Billy is one of the side characters with a chain of missions, and this trophy pops when his final one is done. Side strands can be finished in free roam after the story, according to PowerPyx. Where Billy's strand begins is not yet confirmed in-game. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers are the odd characters you meet in the open world, marked on the map, each with a chain of missions. You need 8 whole strands finished, not 8 single missions. The side-character finals in this guide (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are part of that world, and the stranger icons are worth following whenever you pass one. Nothing here is missable: strands can be finished in free roam after the story, according to PowerPyx. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Randy's mission strand. Randy is one of the side characters with a chain of missions, and this trophy pops when his final one is done. Side strands can be finished in free roam after the story, according to PowerPyx, so leave it for the second phase of the roadmap. Where Randy's strand begins is not yet confirmed in-game. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission in Tyrone's mission strand. Tyrone is one of the side characters with a chain of missions, and this trophy pops when his final one is done. Side strands can be finished in free roam after the story, according to PowerPyx. Where Tyrone's strand begins is not yet confirmed in-game. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY ON THE LIST. Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots at 10 locations, per PowerPyx, and meditating with both Lucia and Jason at one spot counts twice. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. First, Chapter 1: one morning at Jason's house, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia walks to the balcony to meditate. Follow her and accept - that moment is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx flags it as potentially required. Second, the final meditation needs both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. It is still unconfirmed whether the Chapter 1 meditation is required (100% needs only 15 of 18), but doing it costs a minute and removes the risk. Sources: official description; spots, Chapter 1 warning and Coffee Break detail from PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is a side character tied to hunting, and the trophy pops when you take down the one specific animal he wants. Hunting is an activity in the open world, so expect to track the animal rather than stumble on it. Which animal it is and where it roams is not yet confirmed in-game, so this guide does not invent a species or a location. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a collectible, and a set is complete when you hold every card in it. You need 3 whole sets, so keep collecting past the first one and use the in-game collection menu to see which sets are close to done. Card locations are not yet confirmed in-game, so this guide does not list them yet. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 3 sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK It is the game's photo-style activity, so the routine is simple: reach a new spot, use it, move on. The counter tracks locations, so repeating the same spot does not help. Fold it into your exploration runs: every time you visit a new district for another trophy, WAiNK It there too. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges are the small goals the game tracks across combat, driving, exploration and more, and they build up naturally while you chase the other trophies. PowerPyx's roadmap works through 70 of 80 challenges for the 100% checklist, so 50 is a milestone on the way, not the ceiling. Check the challenge menu regularly and mop up the easy ones in free roam. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Your partner is the other protagonist, so this needs both characters together, which PowerPyx says unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Build the wanted level, then break line of sight, hide, and wait for the stars to clear while your partner stays with you. If your partner is left behind or caught, it will not count. Source: the official description; the both-characters detail is from PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. The trick is the middle part: you must keep the same wanted level across all three robberies, so do not let the heat drop between shops, and do not let it spike out of control either. Pick three shops close together, plan the route, and move fast. Both characters together are needed, which PowerPyx says unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Source: the official description; the both-characters detail is from PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Discovery means finding and registering a vehicle type you have not seen before, so variety is everything: drive through different districts, try cars, bikes, boats and aircraft, and scan or enter anything new. PowerPyx's roadmap puts vehicle scanning in the story phase, so start early and let the counter grow as you travel. The exact discovery mechanic is not yet fully confirmed in-game. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-down aiming mode, so the setup is: find a spot with at least 5 enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all 5 before it ends. A gang shootout or a wanted-level fight with several officers nearby is the natural place to try it, and you can retry as often as you like. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA, the Vice City airport. The description is the only confirmed hint, and PowerPyx lists the method as not yet known, so this guide does not invent one. The plain reading is that you leave the airport in an aircraft without a scheduled flight, likely by taking a plane yourself, but that is an interpretation, not a confirmed step. Try it in free roam at the airfield and see if it pops; the method will be confirmed as launch-era guides pin it down. Source: the official description; PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino is the game's tank, and the description is a joke about being inside one, so this trophy is almost certainly about the Rhino tank. The method is not yet confirmed in-game, and PowerPyx lists this trophy among the not-yet-known ones, so this guide does not invent a step. The likely shape is stealing or driving a Rhino, or surviving one, but treat that as a guess until a launch-era guide confirms it. Source: the official description; PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Stealth is the whole requirement: get in, take the goods and get out before any alarm or witness spots you. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before the police are called. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so leave and try again. Which jewelry store and what counts as detected is not yet confirmed in-game, so this guide does not name one. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. A vault only counts if you get away clean, so plan the getaway before the robbery: a fast car parked close, a route out of the area, and no lingering at the scene. Bank vaults are part of the robbery side of the game, and the 5 can be done across the whole playthrough in free roam. Where the vaults are is not yet confirmed in-game, so this guide does not list them yet. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 5.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, so watch for one on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away before the police close in. A fast car and a quiet stretch of road make it far easier than trying it in the middle of the city. Escape is part of the requirement, so do not stop to fight after the grab. Source: the official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida, a count PlayStation tracks. Every named district and region counts, so the job is to visit everywhere: Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the small towns in between. Use the map to find the gaps, and combine the trip with the other exploration trophies, WAiNK It spots, meditation spots and vehicle discovery, so one drive earns progress on several trophies at once. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 52.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations, so you need to hit one per gang, not nine from the same crew. Learn which operation belongs to which gang before you strike, and keep a note of which gangs you have already hit. Gang territories and operation locations are not yet confirmed in-game, so this guide does not list them yet. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 9.

trophies.name: In The Beginning...
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is the whole instruction: find a bar or a spot on Ocean Beach where you can order a cocktail and take in the view. It is a small flavour moment, the kind that pops while you are exploring, so try the beachfront bars while you are there for other trophies. PowerPyx lists the method as not yet known, so the exact spot is not yet confirmed in-game. Source: the official description; PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description is the whole instruction, and PowerPyx lists the method as not yet known, so this guide does not invent a step. The plain reading is that you drive a car through the showroom's glass front, a nod to the classic series moment, but that is an interpretation, not a confirmed step. Try it at a showroom in free roam. Source: the official description; PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The description names the place, so the job is to find that alley, step up to a lane and follow through on a bowl. It is a small activity trophy, so do it while you are passing through that part of the city. Whether a full game or a single bowl is needed is not yet confirmed in-game. Source: the official description, which names the location.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague: a partnership with mass appeal. PowerPyx lists the method as not yet known, so this guide does not invent one. The wording points at a story or partner moment rather than a grind, so it may simply pop as you play through the campaign with both protagonists. One launch-era summary reports it as raising both characters' Strength to maximum, but that is a single unconfirmed report, so treat it as a lead, not a fact. Source: the official description; PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices that change your Criminal Profile. GTABase reports the tracked count as 500 actions that affect the profile, but that is a single source and unconfirmed, so take the number as a lead. In practice, play the game the way the profile measures it: take jobs, make calls that shift your standing, and let the count build across the whole playthrough. It is a volume trophy, not a moment, so it should arrive late and on its own. Source: the official description; the 500 count is from GTABase, single source.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description is the whole hint, and PowerPyx lists the method as not yet known, so this guide does not invent one. The plain reading is a hidden second-chance event: something that fails the first time and works on the retry. It may pop naturally while you play, so do not go hunting for it until launch-era guides confirm the trigger. Source: the official description; PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description is the whole hint, and PowerPyx lists the method as not yet known, so this guide does not invent one. The wording points at a strange, one-off encounter somewhere in Leonida, the kind of secret event these games hide in odd corners of the map. Explore the strange places and it may find you before you find it. Source: the official description; PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The name is a bowling pun, so the target is a person, not a pin. Drive past someone at speed and land the melee hit as you pass. PowerPyx lists the method as not yet known, so the exact vehicle, speed or weapon that counts is not yet confirmed in-game. Source: the official description; PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash you pick up from robberies and jobs, and your contacts clean it for a cut. Keep laundering after every score instead of sitting on dirty money, and the total builds across the playthrough. The tracked target is $250,000 of laundered money. Source: the official description and the tracked amount of $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Every shop counts: clothes, weapons, food, car parts and anything else you buy. Spend naturally as you play and the total climbs on its own, and if it is short near the end, buy the expensive things you have been putting off, such as top-end weapons or vehicle upgrades. The tracked target is $100,000 in total spending. Source: the official description and the tracked amount of $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are the properties that store your vehicles, and you need every one of them, so save up and buy them as they appear on the market. They are a money sink, so pair this with the money-making trophies: launder your Marked Bills, sell what you do not need, and buy a garage whenever you can afford one. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is the in-game vehicle service, so the routine is: find a vehicle, open the app and register it, then move on to the next. Any 10 vehicles should count, so use the cars you already meet while exploring and discovering new ones for Whip It Good. Source: the official description and the tracked count of 10.
